This week, students completed the initial reading and close reading of our anchor book, How Elephants Communicate. Students explored the main ideas and important details in the text. During our third reading, we reviewed Chinese measure words and the phrase structure “adjective + 地 + verb.” We also studied the Tier 1 vocabulary from the anchor book and extended our vocabulary learning by exploring different words and phrases that can be formed with the target characters.

Students completed the anchor book Plant Photosynthesis and learned three important sentence structures: “…像…” (…is like…), “…通过…” (…through/by…), and “如果没有了……，……” (If there were no…, …).
Students retold the process of photosynthesis in their own words to demonstrate their understanding.

Students completed the anchor book Ocean Food Chains and learned two important sentence structures: “… is a natural predator of …” and “Only with … can there be …”
Students wrote a short passage about a land food chain, using Ocean Food Chains as a model.

This week, 5th graders completed Week 1 with our anchor book, 《养宠物》 (Keeping Pets). Students practiced new vocabulary and reading strategies, such as using context and illustrations to understand unfamiliar words and searching for details in the text. On Friday, we completed a shared writing activity and began building our weekly Chinese learning routine.
Tier 1: 问、课、猫、经常、说、同学、兔子、蛇、害怕、照顾、打扫
Tier 2: 宠物、打架、一条（蛇/鱼）、花时间、嘴巴、尾巴、换水
Tier 3: 仓鼠、乌龟、喂食、鱼缸
we will begin our new anchor book, 《野餐活动》 (The Picnic Event), and continue practicing vocabulary and reading comprehension strategies.

Students worked together to discuss and create our class agreements and shared ideas about rewards they would like to earn. We also talked about possible consequences when classroom expectations are not followed, helping students understand how their choices can affect themselves and our classroom community.
We will begin Chinese Reading Unit 1. As we read, students will review Pinyin and practice previously learned reading skills and reading strategies to strengthen their reading comprehension.
Also，the Grade 1–5 i-Ready ELA and Math assessment window begins next week. Students will complete these assessments during the school day.
